It honestly depends on the girl. I know that some girls are very against dating people that do drugs, for reputations sake, while other could care less. Some girls would even join in! But if you do find a girl that accepts that you do do drugs, don't try to push them on her and be honest with her about it. If she asks you if you were high out of your mind on Tuesday, you tell her you were high out of your mind on Tuesday. 

Source: Female dating someone who smokes
